title: Switcher
description: Lays children out in a row, and stacks them when the space is too narrow — no media query.

threshold.description: Width below which the children stack instead of sitting in a row, as any CSS length.

gap.description: Space between the children, as any CSS length.

limit.description: Most children that may share a row; with more than this, they always stack.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
